verdict.rationale: There's no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file — probes for /openapi.json, /swagger.json, etc. all returned 404 — but Shopify does expose machine-readable API descriptions via other means: MCP tool schemas are introspectable at runtime ("Use `--input-schema` against any of these commands to fetch the merchant's live input schema") and the UCP protocol itself has "complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations... hosted in our public GitHub repository." These are equivalents but not a single canonical, easily discoverable machine-readable spec file. missing for 10: a dedicated OpenAPI/JSON-Schema file served at a discoverable canonical URL, confirmation the GitHub UCP spec covers Shopify's specific MCP servers in OpenAPI-equivalent form.
